name: Threads New Tab
tagline: A New Tab page with the field on top, Recently Closed, and every chat as a quiet list.
description: The New Tab page cmux once shipped as its Threads template, rebuilt as a cmux.newtab/1 app from public surfaces only: the field, the tabs you closed last, and every chat (Chats or Projects, a filter, a search), newest first. Remove it and your own New Tab page comes back.
